option_a.label: Rust-dominant
option_a.materials: weathered rust-orange steel body, polished mirror collector panels on backpack/shoulders, sand-faded teal kite-cloth cape

option_b.label: Mirror-dominant
option_b.materials: gleaming chrome-mirror armor, thin rust trim at joints, sun-bleached ochre canvas cape, wing-like solar pauldrons

question: Which material contrast reads better for a desert solar-scavenger: rust body + mirror panels (A) or mirror body + rust trim (B)?
recommendation: A (concept_rust): the rust body sells 'scavenger' while the mirror panels pop as the 'solar' accent; hero render and 3D model follow A.
